inesc.heading: Project SYNTHESIS · Supervised by Prof. Emanuel Gonçalves
inesc.description:
Funded under the project SYNTHESIS.
Development of a specialized bioinformatics tool, GainPro, enabling users to leverage a pre-trained generative AI framework to handle missing values and perform high-accuracy imputation across small-scale to large-scale proteomics datasets.

• Designed and implemented a Generative Adversarial Imputation Network (GAIN), alongside a standard Autoencoder for missing value imputation.
• Implemented MissForest, a classical machine learning approach, alongside a simple mean imputation model to serve as foundational baselines.
• Conducted performance benchmarking comparing the generative model (GAIN) against both the deep learning (Autoencoder) and classical (MissForest) frameworks.
• Developed and integrated an ensemble model combining all the models for a more robust missing value imputation.
• Engineered robust data processing and integration pipelines to clean, normalize, and handle high-dimensional proteomics datasets.
(Ongoing Development: Independent post-grant work is currently underway to implement the pre-trained framework's and finalize the software's deployment features.)
